### Visit us

Malmö Konsthall’s opening hours

Monday closed  
Tuesday 11:00–17:00  
Wednesday 11:00–19:00  
Thursday 11:00–17:00  
Friday 11:00–17:00  
Saturday 11:00–17:00  
Sunday 11:00–17:00

Malmö Konsthall is closed for installation a few weeks before each new exhibition. [More information and deviating opening hours here](https://malmokonsthall.se/en/visit-us/).

Contact us

Telephone: [040-34 60 00](tel:040-3460000)  
E-mail: <info.konsthall@malmo.se>

Address: St Johannesgatan 7, Malmö

Restaurant and café

Restaurant Smak serves lunch and fika. [Click here to visit Smak’s website for opening hours and menu](https://smak.info/).

### Daily guided tours for free (in Swedish)

**Tuesday–Friday 14:00**: Guided tour, 30 minutes  
**Wednesday 18:00**: Guided tour, 45 minutes  
**Saturday–Sunday 14:00**: Guided tour, 45 minutes  

For each exhibition, a free audio guide in English is available. Access it on your phone by [clicking here](https://kulturforvaltningenmalmostadkonst.trales.io/preferences).

## Exhibitions

Malmö Konsthall curates art that challenges and inspires. We present three to four exhibitions per year, with both local and international artists.

[Our exhibitions](https://malmokonsthall.se/en/exhibitions/)

![](https://malmokonsthall.se/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/bokhandeln_bouchra_web-1.jpg)

### Our bookshop

Enjoy one of the largest and most diverse selections of art books in the south of Sweden. In Malmö Konsthall’s bookshop you can find the perfect gift for a friend, or expand your own knowledge of the contemporary art scene.

[Read more about the bookshop](https://malmokonsthall.se/en/visit-us/bookshop/)
